newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - March 11.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - March 11.

text.p: Following is a summary of major Chinese political and business stories in leading newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Beijing. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy. Telephone: (8610) 6532-1921. Fax: (8610) 6532-4978.
- The Communist Party's Central Committee issues a circular on reinforcing and improving party building in state-owned enterprises.
- An editorial calls on state-owned enterprises to improve their party building to try to boost reform and development of the sector.
- China says recent U.S. media reports alleging involvement in campaign donations to the U.S. Democratic Party and attempts to finance members of congress are malicious and untrue.
- Motorola Inc will supply a cellular telephone network with capacity of up to 50,000 subscribers to Beijing's third mobile phone service provider.
- Central bank governor Dai Xianglong says China should limit the number of branches opened by foreign banks that already have branches in China.
- Director of the State Council's Securities Committee Zhou Zhengqing says China should further standardise its securities and futures markets and avoid financial risks in 1997.
- China's soybean output is expected to be 13.5 million tonnes against a demand of 14.1 million tonnes.
- China's cashmere output is expected to approach 10,000 tonnes in 1997.
